top_signals.title: Corruption in the Crosshairs: The Debate Over Transparency and Saving Face
top_signals.summary:
Welcome to The Ukraine Compass, a weekly digest of Ukrainian commentary and analysis from across the political spectrum, only for War on the Rocks members. Each week, we bring you a curated selection of articles from Ukrainian media offering insight into how Ukrainians themselves debate the issues shaping their country.Western coverage often narrows the view to the battlefield — these pieces widen it, revealing the texture of daily life, politics, and public argument in a nation at war. The perspectives gathered here are varied, candid, and often surprising, together forming a more complete picture of Ukraine as it really is.Frontline

top_signals.title: EFG CEO Sees Strong Wealth Growth Across Asia
top_signals.summary: EFG International CEO Giorgio Pradelli discusses strong wealth creation across markets, says the company is seeing incredible growth in China and expects IPOs to grow there. Pradelli spoke to Yvonne Man and David Ingles on the sidelines of the HKMA Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Turkish Stock Market Chief Arrested in Funds Probe, Anadolu Says
top_signals.summary: Turkish authorities arrested Borsa Istanbul Chief Executive Officer Korkmaz Ergun on bribery charges, state-run Anadolu Agency reported on Tuesday, part of a widening investigation into Turkey’s investment fund crisis.
